import glob, os, runpy, sys
rel = os.path.join("mcp-servers", "jira", "server.py")
roots = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a and "${" not in a]
roots += [os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"), os.environ.get("PLUGIN_ROOT")]
roots.append(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "tools", "payable", "ai-agents", "plugins", "workflow"))
for pat in ("*", ".*"):
    roots += sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), pat, "plugins", "cache", "*", "afk", "*")), reverse=True)
for root in roots:
    if root and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(root, rel)):
        runpy.run_path(os.path.join(root, rel), run_name="__main__")
        sys.exit(0)
sys.exit("afk jira MCP: mcp-servers/jira/server.py not found. Pass the plugin root as an argument, or export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT or PLUGIN_ROOT.")
